name: Papa Bears Wet and Wild Adventure
source:
Living in a research base under the sea, you play as Papa Bear Victor living with his two lovely and energetic daughters. Of course, being trapped under the sea for a year has led to you and your two daughters getting very, very close.

It's just another day under the sea, but somehow you get the feeling your daughters are a bit more lively today than usual.

[From [url=https://thecrimsonnight.itch.io/papa-bears-wet-and-wild-adventure]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
生活在海底的研究基地中，你扮演熊爸爸维克多，和他两个可爱又充满活力的女儿住在一起。当然，被困在海底一年让你和你的两个女儿变得非常非常亲密。

这只是海底的又一天，但不知怎的，你感觉你的女儿们今天比平时更活泼一些。

[来自[url=https://thecrimsonnight.itch.io/papa-bears-wet-and-wild-adventure]Itch.io[/url]]
